correctness.rationale: Every boundary case is addressed: x=y, different centers without swaps, one swapped leaf, two or more swapped leaves, each with matching explicit upper and lower recoloring paths; critical spare-color inequality at k=n+1 is proved. Counting disjoint ordered center/leaf transition classes yields the polynomial; maximum coefficient and eccentricity follow by construction. An explicit k=n witness and an n+3 path establish the sharp palette threshold. Independent exhaustive BFS on n=2..5 for k=n+1 and n+2 plus boundary witness at n=3..6 corroborates the proof; finite checks are not substituted for infinite proof.

value.rationale: Unlike the known extremal diameter, the closed two-parameter all-pair distance enumerator determines every metric shell and its size without constructing exponential state spaces; the exact sharp threshold improves the palette by one and explains it structurally through center-leaf swaps. Self-centeredness and exact diametral-pair multiplicities classify a fundamental reconfiguration family and provide a basis for comparisons with nonstar bipartite graphs. This is a natural complete classification rather than an arbitrary small invariant.
